thread:
alex: Quick sync — marketing draft ready for the next release. Need final timing for the public announce, changelog push, docs links, and webinar rehearsal. Thinking Wed Apr 15th 11am PT for the post. ok?
priya: Wed 11am PT conflicts with infra maintenance window. Can we shift to Wed 1pm PT?
jess: 1pm PT works for marketing folks. Product team can do 1:30pm for the rehearsal if that helps.
alex: 1pm PT is fine if eng confirms no risky deploys around then. marco / sam any blockers?
marco: We're running a canary on Dedicated that day. Canary slate is scheduled 12:45–13:15 PT. If we push the announce to 13:30 PT we avoid overlap.
sam: Confirmed — no capacity changes after 13:00 PT. Also want to surface the fallback model variants in the announcement (low-latency fallback).
alex: Good call. We'll add a short note: "automatic fallback to quantized-llama-2-small under high queue" — marketing to keep it plain.
maria: For webinar planning: 30 min demo + 15 min Q&A. Speakers: Jess (product), Marco (eng-ml), Alex (marketing). Rehearsal at 13:00 PT same day?
jess: Rehearsal at 13:00 PT is tight with your canary, but 12:15 PT rehearsal -> 12:45 PT ends before canary. That gives 45m buffer.
marco: 12:15 rehearsal is fine for eng-ml. I'll bring the benchmark slides and the appendix CSV.
alex: Benchmark narrative: marketing wants one headline stat (p50 down ~20% for mixed-concurrency) + appendix with per-route p50/p95 and token costs. Marco can you provide a 1-sentence non-tech blurb?
marco: "Optimized kernels and adaptive batching reduce median token latency by ~20% in real-world mixed-concurrency workloads." Short enough?
alex: Perfect. We'll run that in the blog lead and push details to the docs appendix.
priya: Changelog cadence: engineering will publish the changelog PR to main, then we publish the blog referencing the changelog permalink. Please don't merge the blog until the changelog is merged.
sam: Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/452 — please review.
alex: Docs links: draft PR is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/983 — includes benchmark appendix and how-to for canary routing. Need docs approvals by EOD Tue.
maria: Inbound lead routing: marketing will tag all release inquiries with `release-0.9.2` and set Intercom flow to route to `product-webinars@redwood.com`. Also Zap to SFDC queue `MRKT-Release` so SDRs can triage.
jess: Can we add a short FAQ item about Dedicated vs Hosted latency expectations? Product will write 3 bullets.
marco: I'll upload the benchmark CSV and a short JSON with per-route numbers to the benchmarks folder: https://files.redwood/benchmarks/0.9.2/benchmarks.csv
priya: Deploy-bot shows a scheduled infra window at 12:30 PT. deploy-bot can you confirm canary timeline?
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: 2026-04-15 12:45:00 PT -> 2026-04-15 13:15:00 PT. No other production deploys between 12:00 PT and 14:00 PT.
alex: OK — plan: docs & changelog merged by Tue EOD, rehearsal at 12:15 Wed, canary 12:45–13:15, announce blog publish 13:30 PT, webinar 14:00 PT. I'll update the launch checklist and publish final timings.
maria: I'll create the webinar invite + registration page, set reminder emails, and add the benchmark appendix link.
jess: Who will own the blog PR merge? Alex / Priya?
alex: I'll merge the blog once changelog PR (#452) is green and docs PR (#983) is merged. Priya to sign off on timing.
priya: Signed off for 13:30 PT announce.
sam: Quick note: include a fallback sentence for early responders: "If you see anomalies after the announce please ping #eng-oncall."
alex: Added. Final action items: Marco upload bench CSV, Sam confirm fallback text, Maria create webinar reg, Alex merge blog once changelog+docs green, Priya final timing signoff. Thanks team — I'll drop the publish links here when live. :party_parrot:
alex: (later) Blog draft published: https://blog.redwood.ai/posts/release-0-9-2-preview — still behind PR until changelog/docs merged.
marco: Uploaded benchmark appendix and CSV. https://files.redwood/benchmarks/0.9.2/benchmarks.csv
priya: Changelog PR merged ✅ https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/452
priya: Docs PR merged ✅ https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/983
alex: Merged blog and published at 13:31 PT — incoming inbound routing active, webinar registration live: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar/0-9-2
maria: Webinar registration looks good, autoresponders in place, lead routing to `MRKT-Release` configured.
sam: Monitoring signals running. If anything spikes ping #eng-oncall and tag `release-0.9.2`.
alex: Great job everyone. We'll do a quick postmortem tomorrow morning about the messaging cadence and registrations.
